title: Column Squeeze Mode and Hierarchical Filter Hints for Very Dense Virtual Tables
creator: Maya Chen
description: Introduce a compact presentation mode called "Column Squeeze Mode" that probabilistically compresses low-priority columns in virtualized tables while preserving minimum readable widths and keyboard accessibility. Complement this with a "Hierarchical Filter Hints" pattern: lightweight, inline micro-affordances that expose contextual filter suggestions and group-level filter summaries when space is constrained. Goal: improve information density on high-cardinality tables used in dashboards and logs without increasing horizontal scroll or losing discoverability.
motivation: Customer support and platform teams frequently request denser table layouts for telemetry and routing dashboards. Current density presets either make columns unreadable or force horizontal scrolling. We need a progressive compression strategy that yields 20-40% more visible columns for heavy datasets while keeping key affordances discoverable.
acceptance_criteria: Column Squeeze Mode is toggleable per-table and persisted in user settings
Compression algorithm keeps columns above columnMinWidth token and prioritizes pinned and high-priority columns
Keyboard navigation and screen-reader announcements remain intact (focus order unchanged, aria-labels preserved)
Hierarchical Filter Hints surface top-3 suggested filters per column group and allow one-click apply without opening a full filter panel
Performance: virtualization FPS and initial render time do not regress by >10% on typical 10k-row workloads
Unit and visual regression tests added for three density breakpoints
engineering_considerations: Compression algorithm should run on layout pass and be memoized per data slice to avoid jank
Prefer CSS transform/scale for micro-compression where possible to leverage GPU and avoid reflows
Provide a fallback that disables squeezing for Dedicated/Private deployments if custom fonts affect min widths
Expose an opt-out flag in Column API and a server-side toggle for feature gating
accessibility_notes: When columns are compressed beyond label truncation point, expose full label in accessible name and an explicit tooltip on focus
Hierarchical Filter Hints must be keyboard reachable (tab target) and announce summary counts
Maintain logical reading order for screen readers regardless of visual compression
tradeoffs: Aggressive squeezing increases CPU load on layout but yields higher visible column count; tuned default will favor readability
Inline filter hints reduce discoverability of the full filter builder; we will surface "open full filters" affordance to mitigate
Using transforms for compression results in slight visual scaling artifacts at extreme squeezes; cap at 0.85 scale to avoid illegible text

decisions: Use proportional compression with a hard min width derived from columnMinWidth token
Default Column Squeeze Mode will compress only non-pinned, non-priority columns and preserve user-pinned columns
Hierarchical Filter Hints will show up to three suggested filters per group with count badges and an "Apply" micro-button
Cap visual transform compression at 0.85 to balance density and legibility
qa_checklist: Toggle on/off across density presets and verify persistence
VoiceOver/NVDA: ensure compressed labels announce full text and group summaries
Regression suite: virtualized scrolling and continuous batching scenarios
Edge: custom fonts, RTL locales, and very narrow column sets
